<style id="eatgo-mdd-styles">
  /* Override anti-fondo gris segun elementor-loopgrid-architect */
  html body .e-con.e-parent div.elementor-element.elementor-element-c02covr,
  html body div.elementor-element.elementor-element-c02covr,
  html body [data-id="c02covr"] {
    background-size: cover !important;
    background-position: center center !important;
    background-repeat: no-repeat !important;
    min-height: 220px !important;
    height: 220px !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
  }

  /* Sticky comanda bar styles */
  .elementor-element.elementor-element-m11stkc {
    position: fixed !important;
    bottom: 24px !important;
    left: 50% !important;
    transform: translateX(-50%) !important;
    z-index: 9999 !important;
    max-width: 600px !important;
    width: calc(100% - 24px) !important;
    background-color: #18181B !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) !important;
    border-radius: 50px !important;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) !important;
    padding: 8px 16px !important;
    display: flex !important;
    flex-direction: row !important;
    justify-content: space-between !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
    font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif !important;
    transition: all 0.3s ease !important;
  }

  @media (max-width: 767px) {
    .elementor-element.elementor-element-m11stkc {
      bottom: 12px !important;
      padding: 6px 10px !important;
      width: calc(100% - 20px) !important;
    }
    .mdd-sticky-sub, .mdd-sticky-tag {
      display: none !important;
    }
    .mdd-sticky-btn {
      padding: 8px 14px !important;
      font-size: 12px !important;
    }
    .mdd-sticky-price {
      font-size: 15px !important;
    }
  }
</style>

};

  function applyImages(map) {
    $('[class*="post-"]').each(function() {
      var $card = $(this);
      var m = ($card.attr('class') || '').match(/post-(\d+)/);
      if (m && m[1] && map[m[1]]) {
        var $covr = $card.find('.elementor-element-c02covr, [data-id="c02covr"]');
        if ($covr.length) {
          $covr.css({
            'background-image': 'url(' + map[m[1]] + ')',
            'background-size': 'cover',
            'background-position': 'center center',
            'background-repeat': 'no-repeat',
            'opacity': '1'
          }).addClass('e-lazyloaded e-no-lazyload');
        }
      }
    });
  }

  // Aplicar inmediatamente
  applyImages(knownImages);

  // Fallback si falta alguna
  $.getJSON('/wp-json/eatgo/v1/menu-semanal', function(res) {
    if (res && res.dias) {
      $.each(res.dias, function(dia, info) {
        if (info.platos) {
          $.each(info.platos, function(i, p) {
            if (p.id && p.image_url) {
              knownImages[p.id] = p.image_url;
            }
          });
        }
      });
      applyImages(knownImages);
    }
  });

  // Resolver WPC Quick View modal en botones woosq-btn
  $(document).on('click', '.woosq-btn', function(e) {
    var $this = $(this);
    var pid = $this.attr('data-id');
    if (!pid || pid.indexOf('elementor-tag') !== -1) {
      var postClass = $this.closest('[class*="post-"]').attr('class') || '';
      var match = postClass.match(/post-(\d+)/);
      if (match && match[1]) pid = match[1];
    }
    if (pid && typeof woosq_open === 'function') {
      e.preventDefault();
      woosq_open(pid);
    }
  });
});
</script>
